# WordPress Agent Skills

Installed for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.).

## Official (WordPress/agent-skills)

- [wordpress-router](wordpress-router/) — Classifies repos and routes to the correct workflow/skill
- [wp-project-triage](wp-project-triage/) — Deterministic inspection of a WordPress repository with structured JSON report
- [wp-plugin-development](wp-plugin-development/) — Plugin architecture, hooks, Settings API, security, packaging
- [wp-block-development](wp-block-development/) — Gutenberg blocks, block.json, deprecations, build/test workflows
- [wp-block-themes](wp-block-themes/) — theme.json, templates, patterns, Site Editor troubleshooting
- [wp-rest-api](wp-rest-api/) — REST API routes, schema, auth, response shaping
- [wp-interactivity-api](wp-interactivity-api/) — data-wp-* directives and @wordpress/interactivity stores
- [wp-wpcli-and-ops](wp-wpcli-and-ops/) — WP-CLI operations, search-replace, multisite, automation
- [wp-performance](wp-performance/) — Profiling, query optimization, caching, Core Web Vitals
- [wp-abilities-api](wp-abilities-api/) — Ability registration for agents/MCP
- [wp-abilities-audit](wp-abilities-audit/) — Audit existing abilities and their registration
- [wp-abilities-verify](wp-abilities-verify/) — Verify ability definitions and permissions
- [wp-patterns](wp-patterns/) — Block patterns creation, registration, and management
- [wp-phpstan](wp-phpstan/) — PHP static analysis with PHPStan for WordPress code
- [wpds](wpds/) — WordPress Design System components and style guide
- [wp-playground](wp-playground/) — Playground CLI, blueprints, version switching, Xdebug
- [wp-plugin-directory-guidelines](wp-plugin-directory-guidelines/) — WordPress.org plugin rules and GPL compliance
